verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository for the official Smithery CLI, now maintained under the arcadeai-labs org, so at least part of the product's source can be read. No evidence states an open-source license, and the registry and hosted platform code are not shown as public. missing for 10: a documented open license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for the repository, public source for the registry and platform beyond the CLI, independent corroboration of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The official Smithery CLI (repository now under the acquirer's arcadeai-labs org; installed via npm install -g smithery@latest)
The repository and npm package are live and maintained after the 2026-10-31 shutdown of Smithery's hosted connection services
